In about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a '''skirmish''' took place in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Animiasma]]''.

==The skirmish==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Phylus Mon]] traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Animiasma]]'', and raided a [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], intent on learning the secrets of the creation of [[Sith battlelord]]s. During his raid, Mon used the [[Darkstaff]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that he sought to repair, to rip the [[Force essence]]s from a number of his slaves and transfer them into a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] pyramid. He then returned to the ''Animiasma'' with the pyramid and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] subsequently dispatched the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Oden Malksch]] and a team of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to board the vessel and free the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] essences that were trapped within the crystal.

Malksch and the agents landed on the ''Animiasma'' and made their way through the ship, and they confronted Mon inside his throne room. Mon's bodyguards, the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Mischa Vorfren]] and the [[Blood Carver]] [[Ke Len]], as well as a number of his other slaves, came to his aide and attacked the agents. However, the agents eventually defeated Mon and his minions, and they released the Force essences from the pyramid.
